title: Despicable Me 2
hint_1: A 2013 animated sequel that realized the tiny yellow chaos-goblins were no longer side characters; they were a global merchandising event with goggles.
hint_2: Gru gets recruited by the Anti-Villain League, goes undercover at a mall, and investigates a new supercriminal while his adopted daughters keep making his life inconveniently adorable.
hint_3: This is the part where I stop being polite about it. Purple mutant minions. Jelly guns. A spy romance. A former villain trying to be a dad and failing upward in very pointy shoes.
hint_4: Gru, Lucy, the Anti-Villain League, and enough yellow babbling creatures to make language itself file a complaint.

title: Despicable Me 3
hint_1: A 2017 animated threequel powered by sibling rivalry, 1980s nostalgia, and the apparently eternal public appetite for small yellow beings screaming nonsense.
hint_2: Gru discovers he has a wealthy twin brother with better hair, while a bitter former child star commits crimes with shoulder pads, bubblegum, and a keytar.
hint_3: I'm going to need you to search your memory more aggressively. The villain moonwalks through his evil plan, the brother is named Dru, and the whole thing smells faintly of Rubik's Cube plastic.
hint_4: Balthazar Bratt. Twin brothers. Minions in prison. A diamond heist. If you hear “Bad” and picture a villain with a mullet, you're finally in the right neighborhood.
